mentions.name: The ProxyBox Zero
mentions.description: A zero-config hardware device that connects modern web apps to printers, USB devices, and legacy hardware. It provides both local and public internet access, enabling users to print to their local printers from anywhere.
mentions.source_excerpt: The ProxyBox Zero (https://pbxz.io) - a zero-config hardware solution for connecting your modern web apps to your printers, usb devices, legacy hardware. Provides local and public internet access - print to your local printers from anywhere.
